strings.text: Why TK/K is different
strings.t: Por qué TK/K es diferente

strings.text: The youngest band runs on an **earlier calendar** than everyone else and uses a **readiness model** — WPPSI-IV, Readiness Screening, and Classroom Visit — instead of standardized testing. Three assessment pieces means three appointments to schedule: another reason the early application matters.

strings.text: Gated rather than scheduled up front: "**Once an applicant's file materials are complete, a family interview will be scheduled.**" Student visit days are separate and are **by invitation** — not something a family requests. So the interview date is a consequence of finishing your paperwork early, which is the practical argument for not running to Feb 26.
strings.t: Condicionada en lugar de programada por adelantado: «**Una vez que los materiales del expediente de un solicitante estén completos, se programará una entrevista familiar**». Los días de visita del estudiante son aparte y son **por invitación**, no algo que una familia solicite. Así que la fecha de la entrevista es consecuencia de terminar el papeleo temprano, que es el argumento práctico para no apurar hasta el 26 de febrero.

strings.text: The decision posts to the myCCS decision tab on **April 9, 2027 at 4 p.m.**, with the enrollment contract due **April 16, 2027 at noon** — **except** for a sibling of a JK–K applicant, who is decided on the JK–K track on **February 26, 2027** regardless of the grade applied for. strings.text: The family interview is scheduled only once your materials are complete, and student visit days are by invitation. strings.text: Two weeks earlier than every other grade, and the whole JK/K calendar runs ahead with it. The fee is **non-refundable** and is charged per application. strings.text: Two are required at this band: a **preschool teacher recommendation** and a **pastor's recommendation** — the pastor's form is required at every grade from JK through 11. Both are completed online, so the accurate email addresses you enter in the application are what trigger them. If you give a registrar's email to request records, note that the release is broad: it covers the complete transcript, IQ and achievement test scores, any psychological evaluations, behavior and attendance records, and health records.

Ambos se completan en línea, de modo que las direcciones de correo electrónico correctas que usted introduce en la solicitud son las que los activan. La visita de su hijo es la **Little Lions Assessment**, realizada en un grupo reducido de otros solicitantes de JK/K; a esta edad no hay entrevista con el estudiante.

strings.text: **The instrument changes twice inside this band.** Grade 1 applicants sit the **Weschler Preschool and Primary Scale of Intelligence (WPPSi)** with the JK/K applicants; **Grades 2–4** sit the **Weschler Intelligence Scale for Children (WISC V)**; and **Grade 5** sits the **Independent School Entrance Exam (ISEE)** alongside the middle and high school applicants. For Grade 5, Covenant Day administers the ISEE on campus on **December 12, 2026**, and families may also register through the ISEE's own site; **all Middle and High School testing must be completed and submitted by February 26, 2027**. strings.t: La ayuda es por necesidad y se gestiona a través de FACTS, y se exige una nueva solicitud cada año: una ayuda concedida no se prorroga automáticamente.

strings.text: Before you can be considered, you must provide proof of application for the NC Opportunity Scholarship. Covenant Day accepts the NC Opportunity and ESA+ Scholarships, administered by the North Carolina State Education Assistance Authority.
strings.t: Antes de que se le pueda considerar, debe presentar un comprobante de solicitud de la NC Opportunity Scholarship. Covenant Day acepta las becas NC Opportunity y ESA+, administradas por la North Carolina State Education Assistance Authority.

strings.text: Complete the aid application concurrently with the admissions application rather than waiting for a decision.
strings.t: Presente la solicitud de ayuda al mismo tiempo que la solicitud de admisión, en lugar de esperar a la decisión.

strings.text: Enrollment carries a $1,000 non-refundable deposit per student, applied toward the year’s tuition.
strings.t: La matriculación conlleva un depósito no reembolsable de $1,000 por estudiante, aplicado a la matrícula del año.

strings.text: The FACTS application fee and any reduced deposit for aid applicants are not published — confirm both with the student accounts office.
strings.t: No se publican la cuota de solicitud de FACTS ni ningún depósito reducido para las familias que solicitan ayuda: confirme ambos con la oficina de cuentas estudiantiles.
